lane.reason: The change touches how payments are charged.

findings.title: A retry could charge the card twice
findings.reason: Fixed: the retry now checks the first charge settled.

findings.title: Retries wait longer after each failure
findings.reason: A growing wait is the usual way to avoid hammering the bank.

findings.title: The retry limit lives in the shop settings
findings.reason: One place to change it without a release.

findings.title: Log lines name the order, not the card
findings.reason: Card details never reach the logs.

findings.title: A failed payment keeps its original order number
findings.reason: Ruled earlier: the order number is the customer's receipt.

findings.title: Customers are not told a retry happened
findings.reason: Only the owner can say how much customers should hear.
findings.consequence: A customer may see a second charge attempt on their statement with no explanation.

findings.title: A payment that fails three times ends with no email
findings.reason: Only the owner can say who tells the customer.
findings.consequence: A customer whose card keeps failing hears nothing and may think the order went through.

findings.title: The retry loop never stops
findings.reason: It stops after three tries; the reviewer misread the counter.
